run_when: The rules found a clue, or the company's founders have a finance background.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company deliberately does its own books: the founders state they run their own bookkeeping or accounting (by hand, in spreadsheets, or with AI, MCP or API workflows), or a founder is an accountant who keeps the books.
prompt.definition: Do-it-yourself operators rarely buy services. It lowers the score but never disqualifies; DIY is often a question of timing.
yes_when: The company or a founder says they do their own books or accounting
A founder is a CPA or accountant who handles the company's own books
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is found
unknown_when: An AI or developer-tools company with no statement about its own books
A founder with a finance background but no statement about the books
watch_out_for: A company that sells bookkeeping software or services describes its product, not its own books
Enthusiasm for AI on its own is not DIY
where_to_look: Blog posts about how they run the company

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: ("{company}" OR "{founders}") "our own books" OR "my own bookkeeping" OR "do our own accounting"
good_sources: interviews and podcasts with the founders
